requirement: Every resolved exception must have an assigned operator, a meaningful resolution reason and a chronological record of who changed what.

rules.text: Assign the case before resolving it.
Record a resolution reason of at least 12 characters.
Keep the assignment and resolution in an attributable chronological history.
An observer may inspect cases, but cannot change them.

scope: Resolves a synthetic operations case. Does not change consent or authorize an account-data request.
